QuestInfo.name: Blessings of the Fox God
QuestInfo.0: You greeted everyone in town with the brown rice cakes. You could use some rest, but there's one more custom you need to follow. Ask Silver about it.
QuestInfo.1: Silver says all Pointy-Ear Foxes were born with the blessing of the Fox God. Now that you are a part of this town, Silver wants you to pay a visit to the Fox God as well.
QuestInfo.2: You followed Moonbeam to pay a visit to the Fox God, and got way more than you bargained for.

0.msg: All you need to do now is pay a visit to the Fox God. He is the guardian of all Pointy-Ear Foxes. We are born under his watchful gaze and receive his blessing. It's only proper that you get it too.

1.msg: Can't send you alone, though. You'll probably get lost. Ah! Moonbeam can go with you. Moonbeam, take our friend to see the Fox God. That will keep you out of mischief for at least a few minutes...

2.msg: Oh Grandpa, I'm not a kit anymore! I can take care of myself. Hmph. Well, I'll get there first, so No-Ears here can just follow me. Hey, maybe I should have named you that!

yes.0: Tsk tsk, such attitude. Go on. Moonbeam will be at the Fox Tree by the time your sad human legs get you there.

no.0: You don't have to be so nervous. It's quite simple.

default.0: Moonbeam is already at #rFox Tree#k. You should hurry.
